title: 中式快餐四巨头④麻辣烫：江边纤夫的吃法，被两个东北人开成帝国 | China's Fast-Food Giants P4 · Malatang 🌶️
description:
系列收官——沙县、兰州、黄焖鸡、麻辣烫，你的工位续命神器是哪个？ / Series finale: Shaxian, Lanzhou, chicken rice, malatang — which one keeps you alive at your desk?

第④集·麻辣烫（完结）—— 「中式快餐四巨头」系列，每天一个打工人午餐的国民品牌。
P4 · Malatang (finale) — from the series China's Fast-Food Giants: one everyday lunch legend a day.

一种江边的吃法，最后成了开遍全国的连锁帝国。麻辣烫起源于四川乐山的岷江边：相传当年长江、岷江的船工与纤夫，在江边捡石头支起瓦罐，捡柴生火，从江里舀水、就地取菜，加辣椒、花椒一锅煮熟——既能充饥，又能驱寒祛湿。后来码头小贩把它挑上担子沿街叫卖，慢慢从江边走上了街头。今天的麻辣烫最爽的仪式，是自己拿夹子一样样选菜、再称重算钱，想吃啥拿啥。而把它做成全国连锁的，是两个黑龙江人——杨国福和张亮，硬是把四川江边的这口「烫」，开遍了全国。四川人尝到对味的一口，只会说仨字：巴适得板。
A riverside way of eating eventually became a chain empire spanning all of China. Malatang began by the Min River in Leshan, Sichuan: as the story goes, boatmen and trackers on the Yangtze and Min stacked stones for a clay pot on the bank, lit firewood, scooped water from the river and gathered greens on the spot, then boiled it all with chili and Sichuan peppercorn — filling, and good against cold and damp. Later, dock vendors carried it on shoulder poles and hawked it street by street, and it moved from riverbank to roadside. Today the best ritual is grabbing the tongs to pick your own ingredients, then paying by weight — take whatever you want. The two who turned it into a nationwide chain are both from Heilongjiang — Yang Guofu and Zhang Liang — who spread this Sichuan riverside "boil" across the whole country. When a Sichuan local hits the right bite, they say just one thing: bāshì-dé-bǎn — perfect.
